chain.dataOwner: User and Claude/Codex fleet working in the shared CRM ERP checkout
chain.externalSideEffectBoundary: User authorized push, merge, production deployment and production writes on 2026-08-25. Never delete data or reveal secrets. Real email is permitted only for an explicit employee_id, email, department and role.
chain.parentOutcome: Release the verified CRM-GIT-001 integration through a protected merge and backup-first production deploy, preserving OIDC and avoiding seed/demo business writes.
chain.approvalProvenance: Task 019f88eb-66f2-7661-8818-42ba100ebaf9; user approved revision 1 on 2026-08-24 and explicitly authorized push, merge, deploy, production writes and real email on 2026-08-25.
chain.checkoutWorktreePolicy: Primary is the only writer in the dirty base checkout; no worker worktrees until the base is classified and checkpointed; exact-path and hunk staging only.

subgoals.observableResult: Sales, finance, and leads submodules and parent gitlinks are coherent.

subgoals.observableResult: Coupled files are split into atomic feature bundles.
subgoals.acceptance: Bank and GSheets hunks are staged separately and no commit mixes unrelated features.

subgoals.observableResult: Migration chain is proven on a clean test database.

subgoals.observableResult: Frontend authentication, UI, and test coverage are coherent without accidental UX drift.

subgoals.observableResult: All bundles have atomic local commits and an integration test matrix.
subgoals.acceptance: Every commit has one purpose, backend, frontend, and submodule checks pass, and the index is empty.

subgoals.observableResult: Final verification and a push and deploy handoff package are ready.

subgoals.observableResult: Release regressions are fixed and the integrated branch passes backend, frontend and build checks.
